Apple___Apple_scab.desc: Olive-green velvety spots on leaves and fruit caused by a fungus; worse in cool wet weather.
Apple___Apple_scab.organic: Rake and destroy fallen leaves. Spray neem oil 5 ml/litre every 10 days.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical: Spray Carbendazim 0.5 g/litre or Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre at 10-day intervals.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Prune for airflow, avoid overhead watering, grow scab-resistant varieties.

Apple___Black_rot.desc: Frogeye brown spots with purple rings on leaves; fruit rots into black mummies.
Apple___Black_rot.organic: Remove mummified fruit and cankers. Spray copper fungicide 3 g/litre dormant season.
Apple___Black_rot.chemical: Spray Thiophanate-methyl 1 g/litre from petal fall every 14 days.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Sanitation of dead wood, tree vigour via balanced fertilizer, avoid bark injuries.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.desc: Bright orange-yellow spots on upper leaf surface; needs nearby juniper/cedar trees to spread.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic: Remove nearby junipers or galls. Spray sulphur-based fungicide 2 g/litre.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.chemical: Spray Propiconazole 1 ml/litre at pink bud and again 14 days later.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Do not plant apples near cedar/juniper windbreaks.

Apple___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Keep regular nutrition and irrigation schedule.

Blueberry___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Maintain acidic soil pH 4.5-5.5 and mulching.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.desc: White powdery coating on leaves that curls and reddens them in dry warm weather.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.organic: Spray potassium bicarbonate 5 g/litre weekly. Improve air circulation.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.chemical: Spray Hexaconazole 1 ml/litre or wettable Sulphur 2 g/litre.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen; prune open canopy.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.prevention: Keep orchard floor clean and well drained.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.desc: Long rectangular grey-brown lesions bounded by veins; spreads fast in humid warm weather and cuts yield badly.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.organic: Bury previous crop residue; rotate with legumes. Spray neem oil 5 ml/litre early.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.chemical: Spray Azoxystrobin 1 ml/litre or Propiconazole 1 ml/litre at first lesions.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Use resistant hybrids, 2-3 year rotation, balanced potash.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.desc: Small brick-red to cinnamon-brown pustules scattered on both leaf surfaces.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.organic: Spray garlic+chilli extract or neem oil 5 ml/litre on new pustules.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.chemical: Spray Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre or Oxycarboxin 1.5 ml/litre every 10 days.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant rust-tolerant hybrids early in the season.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.desc: Large cigar-shaped grey-green lesions up to 15 cm long that merge and kill leaves.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic: Rotate crops, plough under stubble, apply well-decomposed FYM.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical: Spray Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre at lesion appearance, repeat after 12 days.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Resistant hybrids and residue management before monsoon.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Top-dress urea at knee-high and tasseling stages.

Grape___Black_rot.desc: Tan spots with black pimple dots on leaves; berries shrivel into hard black mummies.
Grape___Black_rot.organic: Remove and burn all mummies and infected shoots. Prune for sunlight.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical: Spray Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre from pre-bloom every 10-14 days.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Erbigade vineyard sanitation is critical before budbreak.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).desc: Tiger-stripes of yellow-red between green veins on leaves; berries get purple spots and shrivel.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).organic: Avoid large pruning wounds; seal cuts with pruning paste. Remove dead arms.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).chemical: Drench Carbendazim 1 g/litre near trunk after pruning.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Protect vines from drought stress; avoid late-winter pruning.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.desc: Irregular dark brown-black spots that dry the leaf quickly during monsoon humidity.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.organic: Remove infected leaves; keep canopy open; spray neem oil 5 ml/litre.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.chemical: Spray Chlorothalonil 2 g/litre or Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre every 12 days.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Rain shelter or timely monsoon sprays in humid regions.

Grape___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Maintain pruning calendar and soil test based fertilizer.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).desc: Blotchy yellow mottling on leaves, small bitter fruits, twig dieback. Spread by psylla insect - serious.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).organic: Control psylla with neem oil 8 ml/litre sprays; remove infected trees entirely.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).chemical: Spray Imidacloprid 0.5 ml/litre against psylla vector; no cure for infection itself.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Buy certified disease-free saplings; monitor psylla from flush growth.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.desc: Small water-soaked angular spots that turn purple-black and drop out leaving holes.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.organic: Copper oxychloride 3 g/litre at leaf fall and bud swell; avoid excess nitrogen.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.chemical: Spray Streptocycline 0.5 g/100 litre + Copper oxychloride 3 g/litre.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Choose resistant varieties; avoid overhead irrigation.

Peach___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.desc: Small dark greasy angular spots on leaves and fruits in warm rainy weather; defoliation follows.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.organic: Spray copper oxychloride 3 g/litre weekly; use composted nursery mix.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical: Spray Streptocycline 0.5 g/100 litre + Copper oxychloride 2.5 g/litre at 7-day gap x2.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Certified seed, 3-year rotation, drip irrigation instead of flood.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Mulch and steady moisture keep peppers productive.

Potato___Early_blight.desc: Brown spots with clear target-ring pattern on older leaves first; spreads upward.
Potato___Early_blight.organic: Spray neem oil 5 ml/litre; remove lower infected leaves; add potash.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical: Spray Chlorothalonil 2 g/litre or Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre every 10 days.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Healthy seed tubers, wider spacing, adequate potash.

Potato___Late_blight.desc: Water-soaked black patches with white fungal ring under leaves in cool cloudy weather; can destroy crop in days.
Potato___Late_blight.organic: Destroy infected plants immediately; improve drainage; no evening irrigation.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical: Spray Cymoxanil+Mancozeb 3 g/litre or Metalaxyl+Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre immediately, repeat 7 days.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Start protective sprays when night temp 10-20 C with fog/dew forecast.

Potato___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Earth-up ridges and monitor weather for blight alerts.

Raspberry___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.

Soybean___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Soybean___healthy.prevention: Seed treatment with Rhizobium keeps nodulation strong.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.desc: White talc-like powder spreading over leaves; yellows and dries them early.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.organic: Spray milk solution 1:9 with water weekly, or potassium bicarbonate 5 g/litre.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.chemical: Spray Hexaconazole 1 ml/litre or Sulphur WDG 2 g/litre.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Full sun exposure, wide spacing, avoid wetting leaves at dusk.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.desc: Purple irregular spots that merge; leaf edges scorch dry and curl up.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.organic: Remove oldest spotted leaves; mulch to stop splash; neem oil 5 ml/litre.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.chemical: Spray Captan 2 g/litre or Hexaconazole 1 ml/litre every 10 days.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Avoid overhead watering; renew beds every 2-3 years.

Strawberry___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Keep bed mulched and irrigate mornings only.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.desc: Tiny dark greasy spots with yellow halos on leaves and fruits; spreads by rain splash.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic: Copper oxychloride 3 g/litre + neem oil 3 ml/litre weekly; sanitize stakes.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical: Spray Streptocycline 0.5 g/100 litre + Copper oxychloride 2.5 g/litre twice, 7 days apart.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Treat seed with hot water, 3-year rotation, drip irrigation.

Tomato___Early_blight.desc: Brown bullseye target spots on older leaves; concentric rings clearly visible.
Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Mulch to block soil splash; remove infected leaves; potash top-up; neem oil 5 ml/litre.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical: Spray Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre or Chlorothalonil 2 g/litre every 10 days.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Stake plants for airflow, avoid evening watering, rotate solanaceous crops.

Tomato___Late_blight.desc: Greasy black-green blotches with white mold under leaves in cool humid spells; very fast killer.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic: Uproot and destroy infected plants at once; ensure drainage; no night irrigation.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical: Spray Cymoxanil+Mancozeb 3 g/litre at once, then Metalaxyl+Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre after 7 days.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Protective Mancozeb spray before humid cloudy spells; resistant varieties.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.desc: Pale yellow upper spots with olive-grey fuzzy mold underneath - common in polyhouses/humid air.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic: Ventilate polyhouse to cut humidity below 85%; thin foliage; sulfur burner.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.chemical: Spray Chlorothalonil 2 g/litre or Fosetyl-Al 2.5 g/litre focusing leaf undersides.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Wide plant spacing, morning-only irrigation, remove crop debris.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.desc: Many small round spots with grey centres and dark edges starting on lower leaves after fruit set.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic: Remove infected lower leaves; mulch; spray copper soap or neem oil 5 ml/litre.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.chemical: Spray Mancozeb 2.5 g/litre every 8-10 days from first spot.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Never work plants when wet; stake and prune for airflow.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.desc: Fine yellow speckling and bronzing; tiny red mites and webbing under leaves in hot dry weather.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic: Spray water jet undersides daily; release Phytoseiulus persimilis; neem oil 5 ml/litre 3x.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.chemical: Spray Fenazaquin 1 ml/litre or Propargite 2 ml/litre, alternate chemicals to avoid resistance.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Raise humidity around crop, avoid dust roadsides, inspect undersides weekly.

Tomato___Target_Spot.desc: Concentric-ring brown lesions like early blight but also on fruits causing deep sunken spots.
Tomato___Target_Spot.organic: Prune lower leaves; mulch; avoid dense canopy; neem oil 5 ml/litre.
Tomato___Target_Spot.chemical: Spray Difenoconazole 0.5 ml/litre or Chlorothalonil 2 g/litre every 10 days.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Ventilated spacing, drip irrigation, remove volunteer solanaceous weeds.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.desc: Leaves curl upward, turn yellow at edges, plant stunts badly. Whitefly-spread virus - no cure.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic: Remove infected plants immediately; yellow sticky traps 25/acre; net nurseries; neem oil 5 ml/litre vs whitefly.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.chemical: Control vector: Spray Imidacloprid 0.3 ml/litre or Diafenthiuron 1 g/litre weekly rotation.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Grow TYLCV-resistant hybrids; keep nursery insect-proof; manage weeds hosting whitefly.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.desc: Mottled light-dark green mosaic pattern, fern-leaf distortion; spreads by hands and tools - no cure.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic: Uproot infected plants; dip tools in 10% bleach between plants; wash hands with soap.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.chemical: No chemical cure - control by sanitation; manage aphids with Imidacloprid 0.3 ml/litre.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Buy certified seed (virus-tested), avoid tobacco handling near crop, disinfect trays.

Tomato___healthy.desc: Leaf looks normal - no disease detected.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Weekly underside checks catch problems earliest.
